steps.action: Run `OPENAI_API_KEY=dummy GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY=dummy bun run /root/projects/nya2/src/index.ts learn git /tmp/nya-cli-user-testing-learn-hardening-r2/case-004/repo --config /tmp/nya-cli-user-testing-learn-hardening-r2/learn-test.toml --project --json --no-tui` before deleting the marker file
steps.expected: Initial learn indexes both tracked files

steps.action: Delete `deleted-marker.txt`, commit the removal, then rerun the same `learn git` command
steps.expected: Second learn drops the deleted file from the project index

steps.action: Run `search LEARN_R2_004_DELETED_MARKER_9b6e4f2d` and `get deleted-marker.txt` on the relearned project
steps.expected: Search returns zero hits and get fails because the deleted file is no longer retrievable
steps.observed: Search returned `results: []`; `get` exited 1 with `未找到文档: deleted-marker.txt`

assertions.title: Learn Git indexes tracked files only

steps.action: Run `OPENAI_API_KEY=dummy GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY=dummy bun run /root/projects/nya2/src/index.ts learn git /tmp/nya-cli-user-testing-learn-hardening-r2/case-005b/repo --config /tmp/nya-cli-user-testing-learn-hardening-r2/learn-test.toml --project --json --no-tui` on a repo with one tracked token file and one untracked token file
steps.expected: Only the tracked file is indexed

steps.action: Run `search tk7e30d8f4a1` and `search ut9ad1c2e3b4` on the learned project
steps.expected: Tracked token is searchable and untracked token returns zero hits
steps.observed: Tracked search returned `tracked.txt`; untracked search returned `results: []`

frictions.description: `get` rejected `--no-tui` with `Unknown option --tui`; I retried without that flag to validate the missing-document failure path.
An initial untracked-marker fixture shared tokens with the tracked file and returned an unrelated tracked hit; the test was tightened to disjoint single-token markers.
frictions.resolution: Re-ran the assertion in `case-005b` with non-overlapping tracked/untracked tokens, which produced zero hits for the untracked token.

summary: Tested 2 assertions: 2 passed (VAL-LEARN-GIT-004, VAL-LEARN-GIT-005). `bun run smoke:google` passed.
